author: test-reviewer

findings.description: The new test iterates over page values with a for-loop. testing-principles.md § Assertions prohibits loops in test bodies ('No branching in assertions — No if/else, switch, or loops'). Agent Decision Checklist item 4 repeats this. Convert to @ParameterizedTest with @CsvSource({"-1", "0"}) and a single perform/assert body.

Method name 'processFindFormWithPageBelowOneReturnsFirstPage' names the production method (processFindForm), not a behavior. testing-principles.md § Test Naming requires the BDD school 'the{Subject}Should{Outcome}' for tests written from 2026-07-31 onward. A name that survives renaming the handler is required — for example: theOwnerListShouldShowFirstPageWhenPageParamIsBelowOne.

Variable 'tasks' is semantically wrong for a Page<Owner>. testing-principles.md Three-Tier Data Naming requires names that describe role. Rename to 'ownersPage' (meaningful tier) or prefix with 'SOME_' / 'ANY_' if irrelevant.

'new Owner()' is a bare constructor call. testing-principles.md § Test Data Construction states 'Tests never call production constructors directly. Wrap construction in factory methods owned by the test suite. Applies to tests written or modified from 2026-07-31 onward.' Use a factory such as createAnOwner().

The test name claims 'ReturnsFirstPage' but the assertions only verify HTTP 200 and view name — they do not verify that the Pageable passed to the repository has pageNumber=0. A future regression where the clamp targets the wrong value (e.g., Math.max(2, page)) would still pass this test. Add a verify() or argThat() assertion confirming the Pageable.getPageNumber() equals 0.

approved_aspects: The fix is correctly targeted: Math.max(1, page) before PageRequest.of(page-1, ...) eliminates the IllegalArgumentException for all sub-1 inputs
The test does reproduce the original crash: without the fix, page=0 causes PageRequest.of(-1, ...) to throw IllegalArgumentException before the mock is consulted, so status().isOk() would fail
Both page=0 (boundary) and page=-1 (negative) are covered, which are the two canonical cases for this clamp
Mocking usage is consistent with the existing suite and is tolerated by testing-principles.md § Mocking Policy
Tests pass: ./gradlew test exits 0
